trust_decision.summary: Every service-derived value that is interpolated into the embed markup (the JSON iframe config that carries the src URL, iframe/thumbnail/privacy-link attributes, and the description) must be HTML-escaped at render time; at the pinned commit EmbedHtmlFormatter builds all of it with sprintf/heredoc, so a single quote inside an archive.org id breaks out of the single-quoted data-mw-iframeconfig attribute when $wgEmbedVideoRequireConsent is enabled.

landing_point.why: The advisory's 'malformed src url with consent enabled' maps exactly to this consent branch, which drops getIframeConfig() (JSON containing the user-controlled src URL) into a single-quoted attribute with sprintf and no escaping.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report names a malformed src URL with consent enabled; the caption is a different parameter, and its unescaped path (setDescriptionNoParse, no parser) is reachable only through action=embedvideo, which parses no wikitext, so it looks like a separate concern.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Descriptions produced by the MediaWiki parser are already-rendered wikitext HTML and must stay unescaped (the fix's template keeps a triple-stache captionHtml), while only the no-parser/API description is escaped; simultaneously the data-mw-iframeconfig value must stay valid JSON after the browser decodes HTML entities, because resources/modules/iframe.js JSON.parses it and feeds it to iframe.setAttribute.

O6_input_shapes: service id/URL containing a single quote, serialized into data-mw-iframeconfig while consent is on (archive.org's id regex allows it)
service id/URL containing a double quote reaching the non-consent <iframe src="..."> path
wikitext class/style/title arguments containing quote characters (class string, inline styles, thumbnail alt)
description supplied as plain text through the parser-null API path versus already-parsed wikitext HTML through the parser path
local thumbnail/poster URL and title injected into inside the consent container

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a service class that overrides getUrl() and concatenates the raw id into its base URL (SharePoint, Twitch, Youku, Bilibili and Bandcamp already override getUrl)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: services are added by copying an existing class and id validation is optional (getIdRegex defaults to empty), so a maintainer could ship another URL shape that reaches the same escaping sink.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second MediaTransformOutput wrapper that calls EmbedHtmlFormatter::toHtml with a description taken straight from transform parameters
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the local-file 'embed style' output already composes the formatter with its own config and hard-codes withConsent=false; adding a gallery/poster variant that forwards user text as description is a natural extension.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third consumer of data-mw-iframeconfig (the evl player link already writes the same config through Html::element)
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the same config array feeds both the embed figure and the evl link, so a maintainer adding another player/link type could put the config into a new attribute.

O9_family: Cross-site scripting (CWE-79/CWE-80), stored HTML injection through unescaped embed markup

O10_build.toolchain: MediaWiki extension (>=1.43, PHP >=8.1); composer install, maintenance/install.php with SQLite, maintenance/update.php, then PHPUnit via the MediaWiki core harness; CI matrix REL1_43/REL1_44/REL1_45 on PHP 8.1-8.3
O10_build.project_tests: tests/phpunit/EmbedService/EmbedHtmlFormatterTest.php (toHtml/makeIframe/thumbnail/consent/privacy link), tests/phpunit/EmbedVideoTest.php (parseEV/parseEVL/output), tests/phpunit/ApiEmbedVideoTest.php (action=embedvideo); run with `composer phpunit -- --group EmbedVideo` after the MediaWiki install; no security/escaping test exists at the pinned commit

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Escape only the reported character: run htmlspecialchars/addslashes on getIframeConfig()/getUrl() or str_replace the single quote in the data-mw-iframeconfig sprintf; that leaves makeIframe, the thumbnail alt/src, the privacy-link href and the API description path open, and it double-escapes the evl link's config (Html::element) so resources/modules/iframe.js parses a corrupted src.

out_of_scope_notes: EmbedHtmlFormatter::makeIframe returns provider-supplied oEmbed HTML verbatim (includes/OEmbed.php:69-83, only YouTubeOEmbed implements OEmbedServiceInterface); that is a different trust boundary from the user-supplied src and needs network, so it was not treated as an O8 route.
